name: Ioun Stone (Greater Absorption)

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: Absorbs a spell of level 8 or lower aimed only at you (50 levels, then it burns out).
text: An Ioun Stone is named after Ioun, a god of knowledge and prophecy revered on some worlds. While attuned to it, you can toss the stone into the air as a Magic action; it then orbits your head at a distance of 1d3 feet and confers its benefit on you. You can seize the orbiting stone as an action to take it back. This greater absorption stone: Absorbs a spell of level 8 or lower aimed only at you (50 levels, then it burns out).
